entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by the network after starting a de-registration procedure while waiting for a response from the UE.

entities.name: De-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to de-register a UE.

entities.name: Waiting for UE response
entities.description: Condition where the network is awaiting a response from the UE during de-registration.

relations.description: Starting the de-registration procedure causes the network to enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state.
The 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state requires the condition of waiting for a UE response.
